title: Swagger Viewer & OpenAPI Viewer (OpenAPI Preview, 3.1, $ref)
description: Swagger viewer and OpenAPI preview for VS Code. Live Swagger UI or reference layout for OpenAPI 3.1, 3.0 and Swagger 2.0 in YAML or JSON, with external $ref across files, a problem list with line numbers and copyable text. No server, no port, no sign-in, works offline.

title: HTML Preview & HTML Viewer (Live, CSS and Images, Offline)
description: Free HTML preview and HTML viewer beside your editor. Linked CSS, JS and images load, it updates as you type, and nothing is sent anywhere. No sign-in, no server, works offline.

title: RST Preview & reStructuredText Preview (RST Viewer, No Python)
description: RST preview and reStructuredText preview for VS Code with no Python, no Sphinx and no setup. Live preview with scroll sync, grid and list tables, admonitions, code colors, math, images, includes, outline and HTML export. Free, works offline.

title: Zubra
description: Language support for Zubra Web Components: syntax highlighting, diagnostics, completion, hover and go to definition

title: SARIF Viewer (CodeQL, Semgrep & Static Analysis Results)
description: Free SARIF viewer for CodeQL, Semgrep, ESLint, Bandit, Trivy and other static analysis results. Filter by level, baseline and suppression, step through code flows, open each result at its line. No sign-in, no network, works offline.

title: Spring Explorer
description: Explore Spring beans in a dedicated editor panel: dependency levels, injection hierarchy, and REST endpoints

title: Regex Preview & Regex Tester (Railroad Diagram Visualizer, Groups)
description: Regex preview and regex tester beside your code: click "Test regex" above a regex in JS, TS, Python, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Ruby or Rust. Capture groups, replace preview, railroad diagram visualizer, explain mode, flavor warnings. Free, no sign-in, works offline.

title: Agent Tabs: Coding Agents in the Sidebar
description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, pi and other coding agents in tabs in the secondary sidebar, with live status for each agent.

title: Session Branch for Claude Code
description: Shows the git branch of the active Claude Code session in the status bar, right next to the workspace branch, and warns when they differ.

title: Attentry
description: Checks the code Claude Code writes for security holes, crash risks, copied and dead code, and tells Claude right after each edit.

title: Tagged TODOs
description: Groups TODO[tag] comments by tag in a sidebar tree, so you can jump to each one.

title: LYNUCENT - frosted windows
description: Frosted acrylic blur + transparency for your VS Code window (Windows DWM). Alt+X = more glass, Alt+C = less glass.

title: CIE 9618 Pseudocode Syntax Highlighter
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, indentation and folding for Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science 9618 pseudocode.

title: EDI Reader Energie – UTILMD, MSCONS, APERAK, CONTRL (MaKo)
description: German energy market messages (MaKo) in VS Code: read UTILMD, MSCONS, APERAK and CONTRL locally, and see each rejection in the original message.
